dialogues.jp: いつものように、日常を過ごせたと思う。
dialogues.en: This is the last time we eat together......
dialogues.text: This is the last time we eat together......

dialogues.jp: 土曜の夜は、寝るのが少し遅くて。
dialogues.en: I keep looking down and put my mouth to my tea.
dialogues.text: I keep looking down and put my mouth to my tea.

dialogues.jp: 日曜の朝は、起きるのがだいぶ遅くて。
dialogues.en: A gentle silence fills up the room.
dialogues.text: A gentle silence fills up the room.

dialogues.jp: 朝食だか昼食だかを食べて。
dialogues.en: If I do the same thing as I usually do...
dialogues.text: If I do the same thing as I usually do...

dialogues.jp:
ぼんやりとテレビを見て。ポテトチップスをつ
まみながら、マンガを読んで。
dialogues.en:
I usually go back to my room after I finish my tea, and
Yoriko-san goes to the kitchen to wash dishes.
dialogues.text:
I usually go back to my room after I finish my tea, and
Yoriko-san goes to the kitchen to wash dishes.

dialogues.jp:
ＣＤを聴いて。ふと、翌日の宿題が心配になっ
たりして。
dialogues.en:
If I'm supposed to do as I usually do, I should be finishing
my tea and leaving this room by now.
dialogues.text:
If I'm supposed to do as I usually do, I should be finishing
my tea and leaving this room by now.

dialogues.jp: それから、二人一緒に買い物に行って……。
dialogues.en: But I just can't do it tonight.
dialogues.text: But I just can't do it tonight.

dialogues.jp: そんな、毎日の生活を。
dialogues.en:
I'm drinking my tea very slowly, just like hunger-stricken
village people consume their food little by little.
dialogues.text:
I'm drinking my tea very slowly, just like hunger-stricken
village people consume their food little by little.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「お粗末様です」
dialogues.en: "Do you mind if I clean up the table now?"
dialogues.text: "Do you mind if I clean up the table now?"

dialogues.jp:
丁寧に頭を下げる。それも、いつもの光景。明
日からは、見られなくなる……。
dialogues.en: "Oh, go ahead......"
dialogues.text: "Oh, go ahead......"

dialogues.jp: 「まだ、カレー残ってたっけ？」
dialogues.en:
She stands up from her chair, puts all the plates on a tray,
and goes to the kitchen.
dialogues.text:
She stands up from her chair, puts all the plates on a tray,
and goes to the kitchen.

dialogues.jp: 夕飯は、カレーではなかった。
dialogues.en: Then I hear the water running.
dialogues.text: Then I hear the water running.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「あ、はい。冷凍したんです。お腹が空いたら、
　レンジで温めて食べて下さいね」
dialogues.en: "Do you want more tea?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want more tea?"

dialogues.jp:
笑顔を向ける頼子さんに、俺は俯いて、うんと
か、ああとか呟く。
dialogues.en: "Ah, yes, that'd be good."
dialogues.text: "Ah, yes, that'd be good."

dialogues.jp:
一緒に食事を取るのも、これが最後、なんだよ
なあ……。
dialogues.en:
And there's a sound of turning on the heat in addition to
the sound of the water running.
dialogues.text:
And there's a sound of turning on the heat in addition to
the sound of the water running.

dialogues.jp: 俯いたまま、湯飲みに口をつける。
dialogues.en: "I felt asleep yesterday afternoon."
dialogues.text: "I felt asleep yesterday afternoon."

dialogues.jp: 穏やかな沈黙が、部屋の中を満たした。
dialogues.en: She sits at the table as she puts down my steaming teacup.
dialogues.text: She sits at the table as she puts down my steaming teacup.

dialogues.jp: 普段通りなら。
dialogues.en: "And I had a dream......"
dialogues.text: "And I had a dream......"

dialogues.jp:
お茶を飲み終わったところで、俺は部屋に引っ
込み、頼子さんは食器洗いに台所に立つ。
dialogues.en: "......What was it about?"
dialogues.text: "......What was it about?"

dialogues.jp:
いつも通りの日常を演じるならば、俺はさっさ
とお茶を飲んで、席を立つべきなのだ。
dialogues.en: "Yes. ......It was a dream of when I became this form..."
dialogues.text: "Yes. ......It was a dream of when I became this form..."

dialogues.jp: けれど、それが出来ない。
dialogues.en: And she looks down at her body wearing a maid costume.
dialogues.text: And she looks down at her body wearing a maid costume.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「食器、片づけてしまいますね」
dialogues.en: "I'm always......"
dialogues.text: "I'm always......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en:
"I'm always thinking about that time...... So that's
probably why I had the dream."
dialogues.text:
"I'm always thinking about that time...... So that's
probably why I had the dream."

dialogues.jp:
かたんと席を立ち、食器をお盆に載せ、台所へ
と消えた。
水の流れる音が聞こえてくる。
dialogues.en:
What does she want to tell me? She's been thinking about
that time?
dialogues.text:
What does she want to tell me? She's been thinking about
that time?

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「お茶のお代わりはいりますか？」
dialogues.en: "Junichi-san."
dialogues.text: "Junichi-san."

dialogues.jp: 水の音に、ガス台の点火の音が混じった。
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「昨日の昼間、少し、うとうとしてしまったん
　です」
dialogues.en: "Would you come with me to your school......?"
dialogues.text: "Would you come with me to your school......?"

dialogues.jp:
湯気の立ち上る湯飲みを置きながら、頼子さん
は席に着いた。
dialogues.en: "Now?"
dialogues.text: "Now?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「その時、夢を見ました……」
dialogues.en:
I look at the window automatically, but I know it's already
late at night.
dialogues.text:
I look at the window automatically, but I know it's already
late at night.

dialogues.jp:
そう言って、メイド服を身にまとった自分の身
体を見下ろした。
dialogues.en: "We can, but..."
dialogues.text: "We can, but..."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ずっと……」
dialogues.en: "Good. Then I'll get changed."
dialogues.text: "Good. Then I'll get changed."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「ずっと、その時の事ばかり考えていましたか
　ら……。だから、夢に見たのかもしれません」
dialogues.en: "We're going to school."
dialogues.text: "We're going to school."

dialogues.jp:
一体、何が言いたいのだろう？　その時のこと
ばかり、考えていた？
dialogues.en: She says to an empty house with a smile.
dialogues.text: She says to an empty house with a smile.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉さん」
dialogues.en: "I always wanted to go school with you like this......"
dialogues.text: "I always wanted to go school with you like this......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "Except that it's late at night right now."
dialogues.text: "Except that it's late at night right now."

dialogues.jp:
反射的に窓の外に目をやるが、そんな事をする
までもなく、今は夜だと分かっていた。
dialogues.en:
I look up at the sky. It's a clear and beautiful sky with
many stars shining, unlike the other day with many clouds.
dialogues.text:
I look up at the sky. It's a clear and beautiful sky with
many stars shining, unlike the other day with many clouds.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……駄目、ですか？」
dialogues.en: "It is morning to me......"
dialogues.text: "It is morning to me......"

dialogues.jp: 無人の家に向けて、笑顔でそう告げた。
dialogues.en: "What......? What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "What......? What do you mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「こうやって、学園への道を一緒に歩けたらっ
　て、いつも思っていたんです……」
dialogues.en: "......I'm playing pretend."
dialogues.text: "......I'm playing pretend."

dialogues.jp:
空を見上げる。いつかのような曇り空ってこと
はなく、満天の星空だった。
dialogues.en: "......Oh, pretend. So, let's play transfer student?"
dialogues.text: "......Oh, pretend. So, let's play transfer student?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「その……私の中では、朝なんです」
dialogues.en: "Sounds good."
dialogues.text: "Sounds good."

dialogues.jp: 本当に嬉しそうに微笑む。
dialogues.en: She smiles happily.
dialogues.text: She smiles happily.

dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、俺が転校生だな。で、頼子さんに道
　の角でぶつかる、と」
dialogues.en:
"Okay, I'll be the transfer student and I happen to bump
into you on the road."
dialogues.text:
"Okay, I'll be the transfer student and I happen to bump
into you on the road."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……逆だと思います……」
dialogues.en: "......I think I should be the transfer student......"
dialogues.text: "......I think I should be the transfer student......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そう？」
dialogues.en: "You think?"
dialogues.text: "You think?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり、その……私が転校生で……」
dialogues.en: "I play the transfer student......and......"
dialogues.text: "I play the transfer student......and......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「そ、それで、その……運命的な出会いをする
　んじゃないでしょうか……」
dialogues.en: "And... and... I have a fateful encounter......"
dialogues.text: "And... and... I have a fateful encounter......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「バーコード禿げの教頭に？」
dialogues.en: "You want to have a fateful encounter with a bald teacher?"
dialogues.text: "You want to have a fateful encounter with a bald teacher?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……わざと言っていませんか？」
dialogues.en: "......Are you saying that on purpose?"
dialogues.text: "......Are you saying that on purpose?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「割合本気だったり」
dialogues.en: "It can happen, you know?"
dialogues.text: "It can happen, you know?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……いじわるです」
dialogues.en: "......I think you're just trying to be mean."
dialogues.text: "......I think you're just trying to be mean."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ……もう着きました。近いんですね」
dialogues.en:
"Oh...... we're here already. It's very close to your
house."
dialogues.text:
"Oh...... we're here already. It's very close to your
house."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そのおかげで、何度助かったことか」
dialogues.en: "Yes, and that saved me many times."
dialogues.text: "Yes, and that saved me many times."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「遅刻の危機から」
dialogues.en: "It saved me from being late for school."
dialogues.text: "It saved me from being late for school."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ロッカーはきっと、位置が近いですね」
dialogues.en: "I think my locker will be close to yours."
dialogues.text: "I think my locker will be close to yours."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「俺と？　何で？」
dialogues.en: "What makes you think so?"
dialogues.text: "What makes you think so?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「だって……もし転校したら、きっと、同じク
　ラスです……」
dialogues.en:
"Because...... if I get transferred here, I think we'll be
in the same class."
dialogues.text:
"Because...... if I get transferred here, I think we'll be
in the same class."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、まあ……」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I see......"
dialogues.text: "Oh, I see......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「あら？　でも、ロッカーってクラスごとの並
　びだったけか？」
dialogues.en:
"But wait. I'm not sure if lockers are allocated in an
alphabetical order or by class."
dialogues.text:
"But wait. I'm not sure if lockers are allocated in an
alphabetical order or by class."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「え？　違うんですか？」
dialogues.en: "What? I thought they're by class."
dialogues.text: "What? I thought they're by class."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「さあ、どっちだったろ？」
dialogues.en: "I'm not sure."
dialogues.text: "I'm not sure."

dialogues.jp:
くすくすと笑いながら、逃げるように小走りに
した。
dialogues.en: I teasingly chuckle and walk on.
dialogues.text: I teasingly chuckle and walk on.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「私は、自分の教室がどこだか、分からないん
　ですよ。だから、案内して下さいね」
dialogues.en:
"I don't know where my classroom is. So you're supposed to
take me to my classroom."
dialogues.text:
"I don't know where my classroom is. So you're supposed to
take me to my classroom."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「つっても、俺が知っているのは自分のクラス
　だけだぜ」
dialogues.en: "But I know only where my classroom is."
dialogues.text: "But I know only where my classroom is."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ええ……。そこが、いいんです」
dialogues.en: "Yes...... That's fine."
dialogues.text: "Yes...... That's fine."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「なるほど。だったら、おやすいご用」
dialogues.en: "Okay, then it's a piece of cake."
dialogues.text: "Okay, then it's a piece of cake."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ここが、私のクラス……」
dialogues.en: "This is my classroom......"
dialogues.text: "This is my classroom......"

dialogues.jp: ドアに向いて、頼子さんが呟きをもらす。
dialogues.en: She murmurs at the door.
dialogues.text: She murmurs at the door.

dialogues.jp: 「そして、俺のクラスでもある」
dialogues.en: "And also mine as well."
dialogues.text: "And also mine as well."

dialogues.jp: 振り返り、微笑を俺に向けた。
dialogues.en: She turns around to look at me and smiles.
dialogues.text: She turns around to look at me and smiles.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「転校生は、まずは自己紹介ですよね……」
dialogues.en:
"Usually a transfer student starts off by introducing
herself, right......?"
dialogues.text:
"Usually a transfer student starts off by introducing
herself, right......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そうだね」
dialogues.en: "That's right."
dialogues.text: "That's right."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「ざわついていたクラスの中に、講師と一緒に
　入って行くんだ」
dialogues.en: "You usually go into the noisy classroom with your teacher."
dialogues.text: "You usually go into the noisy classroom with your teacher."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「途端に静まる教室。黒板に名前を書いて、ク
　ラスの連中の前で、名前を告げる……」
dialogues.en:
"All of a sudden, everybody turns quiet. You write your name
on the board and introduce yourself to everyone in the
class."
dialogues.text:
"All of a sudden, everybody turns quiet. You write your name
on the board and introduce yourself to everyone in the
class."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「転校生への注目が一番集まる瞬間……。俺は
　経験ないから分からないけど、やっぱ、緊張
　するんだろうな」
dialogues.en:
"It's the moment when you get all the students' attention.
I've never experienced being a transfer student, but I can
easily guess I'd be very nervous if I were you."
dialogues.text:
"It's the moment when you get all the students' attention.
I've never experienced being a transfer student, but I can
easily guess I'd be very nervous if I were you."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫ですよ」
dialogues.en: "It'll be okay."
dialogues.text: "It'll be okay."

dialogues.jp:
教室に向き直る。頼子さんは、そっと中に踏み
だした。
dialogues.en: She turns to the door and slowly steps inside the room.
dialogues.text: She turns to the door and slowly steps inside the room.

dialogues.jp: それは、いつか夢で見た光景に似ていた。
dialogues.en: It looks just like the dream I had before.
dialogues.text: It looks just like the dream I had before.

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんは柔らかな笑みを浮かべ、教室にしっ
かりと視線を向けている。
dialogues.en: She has a gentle smile on her face, looking up straight.
dialogues.text: She has a gentle smile on her face, looking up straight.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「｛さぎさわ／鷺澤｝頼子と申します。よろしくお願いします」
dialogues.en: "My name is Yoriko Sagisawa. It's very nice to meet you..."
dialogues.text: "My name is Yoriko Sagisawa. It's very nice to meet you..."

dialogues.jp: ぺこりと、頭を下げた。
dialogues.en: And she bows.
dialogues.text: And she bows.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「自己紹介が終わったら、やっぱり次は、学園
　の中の案内ですよね」
dialogues.en:
"Usually I can get to look around the school after finishing
my introduction, right?"
dialogues.text:
"Usually I can get to look around the school after finishing
my introduction, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「え？　でも、この前色々と見て……」
dialogues.en:
"What? Yeah, but I already showed you around last
time......"
dialogues.text:
"What? Yeah, but I already showed you around last
time......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「でも、今の私は、知りませんよ……」
dialogues.en: "But I, as a transfer student, haven't......"
dialogues.text: "But I, as a transfer student, haven't......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そうか、そうだよな……」
dialogues.en: "You're right......"
dialogues.text: "You're right......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「よし、それじゃ、回ろっか」
dialogues.en: "Right! I'll show you around."
dialogues.text: "Right! I'll show you around."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「色々案内するぜ。購買や食堂の場所はもちろ
　ん、昼寝に持ってこいの場所とか、学生だけ
　が知っている秘密の抜け道とか」
dialogues.en:
"I'll show you everywhere in this school. I'll start with
the store where you can purchase your schoolbooks, the
cafeteria, the best place when you want to have a nap, and
the secret path out of this school that only students know."
dialogues.text:
"I'll show you everywhere in this school. I'll start with
the store where you can purchase your schoolbooks, the
cafeteria, the best place when you want to have a nap, and
the secret path out of this school that only students know."

dialogues.jp:
ニヤリと笑ってみせる。頼子さんは、秘密めか
した微笑を浮かべた。
dialogues.en: I smile proudly. Yoriko-san smiles with an air of secrecy.
dialogues.text: I smile proudly. Yoriko-san smiles with an air of secrecy.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「よろしくお願いします」
dialogues.en: "Thank you so much."
dialogues.text: "Thank you so much."

dialogues.jp: ゆっくりと回った。
dialogues.en: We walk slowly.
dialogues.text: We walk slowly.

dialogues.jp: 噛んで含めるように、とてもゆっくりと。
dialogues.en: Very slowly, as if we were chewing very delicious food.
dialogues.text: Very slowly, as if we were chewing very delicious food.

dialogues.jp: 時間を掛ければ掛けるほど。
dialogues.en: We want to believe that the longer time we take to walk...
dialogues.text: We want to believe that the longer time we take to walk...

dialogues.jp: 時は、緩やかに流れていくと信じて……。
dialogues.en: The slower time passes......
dialogues.text: The slower time passes......

dialogues.jp:
二人のかけがえのない時間を、引き伸ばしてく
れると信じて……。
dialogues.en: We want to believe our precious time could be extended......
dialogues.text: We want to believe our precious time could be extended......

dialogues.jp:
それでも、時計の針は、恐ろしいまでに歩んで
いく。
dialogues.en:
However, the hands of the clock are moving faster than we
wished.
dialogues.text:
However, the hands of the clock are moving faster than we
wished.

dialogues.jp:
焦りもしなければ、怠けもせず、着実にその時
へと向かって。
dialogues.en:
They move steadily, both without rushing and without
neglecting its job to reach that moment.
dialogues.text:
They move steadily, both without rushing and without
neglecting its job to reach that moment.

dialogues.jp: 枯れずの桜が枯れるという、その時へ。
dialogues.en: The time when the never-dying cherry tree will die.
dialogues.text: The time when the never-dying cherry tree will die.

dialogues.jp: そして……。

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そろそろ、時間ですね……」
dialogues.en: "It's almost that time......"
dialogues.text: "It's almost that time......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉さん？」
dialogues.en: "......Junichi-san?"
dialogues.text: "......Junichi-san?"

dialogues.jp:
なかなか出ない声に、思わず首を締めたくなる。
そうすれば、絞り出されるだろう。
dialogues.en: I have to choke my neck so that I can squeeze out a word.
dialogues.text: I have to choke my neck so that I can squeeze out a word.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……行きましょう」

言葉は出さず、こくりとうなずく。ともかく、
意思はそれで伝える事が出来る。
dialogues.en:
I don't say a word, but just nod. At least I can still
express my intention like that.
dialogues.text:
I don't say a word, but just nod. At least I can still
express my intention like that.

dialogues.jp: 残り時間を意識してか、歩く速度は早かった。
dialogues.en:
She walks fast, probably because she knows how long she has
left.
dialogues.text:
She walks fast, probably because she knows how long she has
left.

dialogues.jp: もう、余裕はない。
dialogues.en: And there isn't much time left.
dialogues.text: And there isn't much time left.

dialogues.jp: ヒミツキチ。
dialogues.en: My hideout.
dialogues.text: My hideout.

dialogues.jp: その昔、そんな言葉で呼んでいた場所だ。
dialogues.en: That's what I used to call this place when I was little.
dialogues.text: That's what I used to call this place when I was little.

dialogues.jp:
そして、そこにはやっぱり秘密が隠されていた
らしい。
dialogues.en: And it turned out to have a hidden secret after all.
dialogues.text: And it turned out to have a hidden secret after all.

dialogues.jp:
春の夜は風が強く、舞い散る桜が、渦を巻いて
いる。
dialogues.en:
The spring wind at night is very strong, and the cherry
trees are waving roughly.
dialogues.text:
The spring wind at night is very strong, and the cherry
trees are waving roughly.

dialogues.jp:
そんな渦の、恐らくは中央に、魔女と呼ばれた
桜と──、
dialogues.en:
And in the middle of it all, there's the cherry tree that
Yoriko-san called a witch, and......
dialogues.text:
And in the middle of it all, there's the cherry tree that
Yoriko-san called a witch, and......

dialogues.jp: さくらが居た。
dialogues.en: And there's Sakura.
dialogues.text: And there's Sakura.

dialogues.jp: 「あいつ……何やってるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What...... is she doing here?"
dialogues.text: "What...... is she doing here?"

dialogues.jp:
まるで、何かを祈っているような姿だ。桜の大
木に身をまかせ、微動だにしない。
dialogues.en:
She looks like she's praying. She doesn't move a bit,
resting her entire weight on the cherry tree.
dialogues.text:
She looks like she's praying. She doesn't move a bit,
resting her entire weight on the cherry tree.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「芳乃さんから……聞きました？」
dialogues.en: "Did Sakura-san tell you......?"
dialogues.text: "Did Sakura-san tell you......?"

dialogues.jp:
呆けたように光景を見やっていた俺は、一拍遅
れて、頼子さんに顔を向けた。
dialogues.en:
I was lost in surprise looking foolish, but I turn around to
Yoriko-san.
dialogues.text:
I was lost in surprise looking foolish, but I turn around to
Yoriko-san.

dialogues.jp: 「何が？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「桜を枯らしてしまうという事に関して……で
　す」
dialogues.en: "Did she tell you that she can kill the cherry tree...?"
dialogues.text: "Did she tell you that she can kill the cherry tree...?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ああ、聞いたような、聞いてないような」
dialogues.en: "Ah, yeah...... I think she told me something like that."
dialogues.text: "Ah, yeah...... I think she told me something like that."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「島のみんなのためだからと、そう言っていま
　した」
dialogues.en:
"She told me she has to do it for the people of this
island."
dialogues.text:
"She told me she has to do it for the people of this
island."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「島の……みんなの？」
dialogues.en: "For the people of this...... island?"
dialogues.text: "For the people of this...... island?"

dialogues.jp: 改めて、桜とさくらに視線を向ける。
dialogues.en: I look at Sakura and the cherry tree again.
dialogues.text: I look at Sakura and the cherry tree again.

dialogues.jp:
後、時間はどれだけ残されているのだろう？　
２分？　１分？　それとも……。
dialogues.en:
How long does Yoriko-san have left? 2 minutes? 1 minute?
Or......
dialogues.text:
How long does Yoriko-san have left? 2 minutes? 1 minute?
Or......

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「私があの人を恨んでいると……そう、思いま
　すか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you think I hold a grudge against her?"
dialogues.text: "Do you think I hold a grudge against her?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あの桜が枯れれば、頼子さんが消えるから？」
dialogues.en: "Because you will disappear if the cherry tree dies?"
dialogues.text: "Because you will disappear if the cherry tree dies?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
恨んでいるだろう、そう答えるには、その表情
はあまりにも穏やかだった。
dialogues.en:
At first I thought she did, but the gentle expression on her
face tells me a different answer.
dialogues.text:
At first I thought she did, but the gentle expression on her
face tells me a different answer.

dialogues.jp: 頼子さんはゆっくりと首を振った。
dialogues.en: Yoriko slowly shakes her head.
dialogues.text: Yoriko slowly shakes her head.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……そんなことはありません」

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「たとえ、目的が今のように立派じゃなかった
　としても……」
dialogues.en:
"Even if my goal was not something I could be proud to
have......"
dialogues.text:
"Even if my goal was not something I could be proud to
have......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「目的などない、ただの気まぐれであったとし
　ても……」
dialogues.en:
"Even if I didn't have any goal at all and it was just a
wanton desire......"
dialogues.text:
"Even if I didn't have any goal at all and it was just a
wanton desire......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「それでも私は……恨みなど、決してしなかっ
　たでしょう……」
dialogues.en: "I would never have held any grudge against her......"
dialogues.text: "I would never have held any grudge against her......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「何故なら、それは、私自身、望んでいたこと
　だから……」
dialogues.en: "Because this is what I wished......"
dialogues.text: "Because this is what I wished......"

dialogues.jp: ｛あぜん／唖然｝として、あんぐりと口を開ける。
dialogues.en: I was speechless.
dialogues.text: I was speechless.

dialogues.jp:
忘却に追いやられた言葉を取り戻し、俺はやっ
と声を出す。
dialogues.en: But I finally find a word I lost in wonder, and say to her,
dialogues.text: But I finally find a word I lost in wonder, and say to her,

dialogues.jp: 「……どうして？」
色々な意味が込められた“どうして？”だった。
dialogues.en: The 'why?' had so many meanings.
dialogues.text: The 'why?' had so many meanings.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとうございました」
dialogues.en: "Thank you so much."
dialogues.text: "Thank you so much."

dialogues.jp: そう言って、頼子さんがぺこりと頭を下げる。
dialogues.en: She bows.
dialogues.text: She bows.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「みんな、みんな、あなたのおかげなんです」
dialogues.en: "I thank you for everything."
dialogues.text: "I thank you for everything."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「思い出も、たくさんもらいました」
dialogues.en: "You gave me many memories."
dialogues.text: "You gave me many memories."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「私が作った料理を、美味しいと言ってくれま
　した」
dialogues.en: "You told me that you liked the meals I cooked."
dialogues.text: "You told me that you liked the meals I cooked."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「私が外に出られるようにしてくれました」
dialogues.en: "You made me be able to go outside by myself."
dialogues.text: "You made me be able to go outside by myself."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「デートもしてくれました。キスもしてくれま
　した」
dialogues.en: "You went out for a date with me and you kissed me."
dialogues.text: "You went out for a date with me and you kissed me."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「私のことを、好きだと言ってくれました」
dialogues.en: "You told me you loved me."
dialogues.text: "You told me you loved me."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「あなたと一緒に過ごした時間は、短かったか
　もしれないけれど……」
dialogues.en: "The time I spent with you was a short time, but......"
dialogues.text: "The time I spent with you was a short time, but......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「それでも、私のこれまでの一生を費やしても
　追い抜けないくらい、たくさんの思い出です」
dialogues.en:
"You gave me more memories than I could ever make by
spending the rest of my life."
dialogues.text:
"You gave me more memories than I could ever make by
spending the rest of my life."

dialogues.jp: 桜へと目を向けた。
dialogues.en: I look up at the cherry tree.
dialogues.text: I look up at the cherry tree.

dialogues.jp: 何かが高まりつつあった。
dialogues.en: Something's growing inside of me.
dialogues.text: Something's growing inside of me.

dialogues.jp: この時間は、もうすぐ終わる……。
dialogues.en: This time will be over soon......
dialogues.text: This time will be over soon......

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「私が、元の姿に戻ることを受け入れることが
　出来るのも……」
dialogues.en:
"The reason I can accept returning to what I really
am......"
dialogues.text:
"The reason I can accept returning to what I really
am......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「全部、朝倉さんのおかげなんです……」
dialogues.en: "......is because of you, Junichi-san......"
dialogues.text: "......is because of you, Junichi-san......"

dialogues.jp: 溜めていた空気を、ゆっくりと吐き出す。
dialogues.en: I slowly exhale the air I was holding.
dialogues.text: I slowly exhale the air I was holding.

dialogues.jp:
日本語を喋れるという事実を強く意識して、よ
うやく言葉を紡ぎ出す。
dialogues.en:
I remind myself that I can speak Japanese and finally
squeezed some words out.
dialogues.text:
I remind myself that I can speak Japanese and finally
squeezed some words out.

dialogues.jp: 頼子さんへと向けて……。
dialogues.en: To Yoriko-san......
dialogues.text: To Yoriko-san......

dialogues.jp: 「俺はさ、頼子さん……」
dialogues.en: "Yoriko-san, I......"
dialogues.text: "Yoriko-san, I......"

dialogues.jp: 「ただ、頼子さんが好きなだけだったんだ」
dialogues.en: "I'm no one but just a guy who loves you."
dialogues.text: "I'm no one but just a guy who loves you."

dialogues.jp:
「俺は、聖人君子でもなければ、スーパーマン
　でもない」
dialogues.en: "I am not a saint or a superman."
dialogues.text: "I am not a saint or a superman."

dialogues.jp: 「ただ、君が好きだっただけ……」
dialogues.en: "I'm just a guy who loves you......"
dialogues.text: "I'm just a guy who loves you......"

dialogues.jp: 桜の渦が強くなった。
dialogues.en: Cherry blossom petals start to move in a big swirl.
dialogues.text: Cherry blossom petals start to move in a big swirl.

dialogues.jp:
視界を埋め尽くす花びら。自分自身が、それに
同化してしまったような錯覚を覚える。
dialogues.en:
Petals are everywhere around me, and I feel like I just
became one of them.
dialogues.text:
Petals are everywhere around me, and I feel like I just
became one of them.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「私が夢見ていたよりも……」
dialogues.en: "You are a much more wonderful person......"
dialogues.text: "You are a much more wonderful person......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「実際は、もっとずっと、素敵でしたよ。
　……朝倉さん」
dialogues.en: "......than you were in my dream, Junichi-san......"
dialogues.text: "......than you were in my dream, Junichi-san......"

dialogues.jp: 風が止んだ。
dialogues.en: The wind stops.
dialogues.text: The wind stops.

dialogues.jp: 声が途切れた。
dialogues.en: Our conversation stops.
dialogues.text: Our conversation stops.

dialogues.jp: 恐ろしいほどの静寂。
dialogues.en: It's scarily quiet.
dialogues.text: It's scarily quiet.

dialogues.jp: ふと足下に目をやる。
dialogues.en: I look down at my feet.
dialogues.text: I look down at my feet.

dialogues.jp: こんもりとした、服の山。
dialogues.en: There's a pile of clothes.
dialogues.text: There's a pile of clothes.

dialogues.jp:
それは、俺のものだ。俺が、頼子さんに貸して
いた──。
dialogues.en:
They're mine. My clothes that Yoriko-san borrowed to wear
----
dialogues.text:
They're mine. My clothes that Yoriko-san borrowed to wear
----

dialogues.jp:
その下に、何かの生き物が隠れているかのよう
に、Ｙシャツの下で何かが動いた。
dialogues.en:
And under the clothes, something moves, like a creature
trying to hide.
dialogues.text:
And under the clothes, something moves, like a creature
trying to hide.

dialogues.jp: 透けて見える色。出口を求める、小さな身体。
dialogues.en: It's small and trying to find a way out.
dialogues.text: It's small and trying to find a way out.

dialogues.jp: ｛えりくび／襟首｝から首を出して……、
dialogues.en: It pokes its head through the collar of my shirt.
dialogues.text: It pokes its head through the collar of my shirt.

dialogues.jp: ◆終わり◆
dialogues.en: ◆I think I did spend the days as I usually do.◆
dialogues.text: ◆I think I did spend the days as I usually do.◆

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんとの別れが約束されていたその日、俺
は約束通り、いつも通りの日常を過ごせたと、
そう思う。
dialogues.en: I went to bed a little late on Saturday night.
dialogues.text: I went to bed a little late on Saturday night.

dialogues.jp: 頼子さんは、一緒に学園に行きたいと言った。
dialogues.en: I got up late on Sunday morning.
dialogues.text: I got up late on Sunday morning.

dialogues.jp:
空には満天の星空が広がっているが、頼子さん
は今が朝だと言う。彼女の、それは｛・・・・・／ごっこ遊び｝
だった。
dialogues.en: I had brunch.
dialogues.text: I had brunch.

dialogues.jp:
俺は頼子さんに合わせて、そのごっこに付き合
い、転校生という設定の頼子さんに、学園の中
を案内してまわった。
dialogues.en: I watched TV. I read a magazine with chips.
dialogues.text: I watched TV. I read a magazine with chips.

dialogues.jp: ――そして、その瞬間は迫っていた。
dialogues.en:
I listened to my CDs. I worried whether I had homework or
not.
dialogues.text:
I listened to my CDs. I worried whether I had homework or
not.

dialogues.jp:
その瞬間――枯れない桜が枯れる時――に向かっ
て、俺たちの足も、自然とあの場所へと向かっ
ていた。
dialogues.en: And we went shopping together......
dialogues.text: And we went shopping together......

dialogues.jp: ――ヒミツキチ。
dialogues.en: I spent time as I do every day.
dialogues.text: I spent time as I do every day.

dialogues.jp:
そしてその、狂おうように舞い散る桜の花びら
と、ざわざわと落ち着かない桜の木々の渦中に、
その木と、魔女の少女が｛たたず／佇｝んでいた。
dialogues.en: And as Yoriko-san wished.
dialogues.text: And as Yoriko-san wished.

dialogues.jp:
いよいよ、桜の枯れる時が来るのだろう。俺は
少し、落ち着かなかった。
dialogues.en: "It was a very good dinner."
dialogues.text: "It was a very good dinner."

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんは、さくらのことを恨んでいると思う
か？　と｛たず／訊｝ねてきた。恨んでいるにしては、あ
まりに穏やかな顔に、俺が口を｛つぐ／噤｝んでいると、
dialogues.en: Our last dinner together is over.
dialogues.text: Our last dinner together is over.

dialogues.jp:
素敵な日々に、こんなことにでもならなければ、
絶対に体験できなかったこと全てに、感謝をし
ていると言った。
dialogues.en: "I'm glad you liked them."
dialogues.text: "I'm glad you liked them."

dialogues.jp:
例えこれが、誰かの気まぐれによって起きた奇
跡だったのだとしても、彼女にとってそれは大
切な思い出で、かけがえの無いものだと言う。
dialogues.en:
She gently bows. It's the same picture as always. But I
won't get to see it from tomorrow......
dialogues.text:
She gently bows. It's the same picture as always. But I
won't get to see it from tomorrow......

dialogues.jp:
俺のおかげだ、という頼子さんに、俺も、ただ
君のことが好きだっただけだ、と伝えた。本当
にそれだけなんだ。
dialogues.en: "Didn't we have some more curry left?"
dialogues.text: "Didn't we have some more curry left?"

dialogues.jp:
風が止み、声が途切れ、恐ろしいほどの静寂に
あたりが包まれた。
dialogues.en: Tonight's dinner wasn't curry.
dialogues.text: Tonight's dinner wasn't curry.

dialogues.jp:
足元には、頼子さんの着ていた、俺の服の山。
その中でもぞもぞと動く、小さな影。そして、
影はひょいと首を出した。
dialogues.en:
"Yes, we still do...... I put it in the freezer. You can
microwave it and eat it when you're hungry."
dialogues.text:
"Yes, we still do...... I put it in the freezer. You can
microwave it and eat it when you're hungry."

dialogues.jp: ――小さな声で鳴いていた。
dialogues.en: She smiles and I nod.
dialogues.text: She smiles and I nod.
